actors.name: Gustavo
actors.private_context: Gustavo is a mid-tier sales rep at Brightline Software, selling invoice-automation software. He has a list of forty procurement leads at mid-market manufacturers in the Pacific Northwest. He plans to cold-email them this week. His usual booking rate is about one discovery call per sixty cold emails.

shared_context: Gustavo has a list of forty procurement leads at mid-market manufacturers in the Pacific Northwest. He can send cold emails to these leads through standard email channels. The leads may or may not respond to such emails.

starting_events.description: Gustavo begins sending cold emails to the forty procurement leads.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least one of the forty leads actually sent a reply agreeing to a discovery call before 2026-08-31T17:00:00-07:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
